command:
cd /etc/ansible-config-sync && cat > sync-app-conf.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: Read source of truth from node1
  hosts: source
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Read and checksum /etc/inventory/app.conf
      ansible.builtin.raw: sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf | awk '{print $1}' && cat /etc/inventory/app.conf | base64 -w0
      register: source_read
      changed_when: false

- name: Synchronize app.conf onto node2
  hosts: target
  gather_facts: false
  vars:
    source_lines: "{{ hostvars['node1'].source_read.stdout_lines }}"
    source_sha256: "{{ source_lines[0] }}"
    source_b64: "{{ source_lines[1] }}"
  tasks:
    - name: Ensure /etc/inventory exists
      ansible.builtin.raw: sudo mkdir -p /etc/inventory && sudo chown antrieb:antrieb /etc/inventory
      changed_when: false

    - name: Check current checksum on node2
      ansible.builtin.raw: sha256sum /etc/inventory/app.conf 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true
      register: target_check
      changed_when: false

    - name: Write app.conf if it differs from node1
      ansible.builtin.raw: >-
        echo '{{ source_b64 }}' | base64 -d | sudo tee /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp > /dev/null &&
        sudo chown antrieb:antrieb /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp &&
        sudo chmod 644 /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp &&
        sudo mv /etc/inventory/app.conf.tmp /etc/inventory/app.conf
      when: target_check.stdout_lines[0] | default('') != source_sha256
      register: write_result

    - name: Report sync outcome
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: >-
          {{ 'app.conf updated on node2 (source sha256=' + source_sha256 + ')'
             if write_result is changed
             else 'app.conf already in sync (sha256=' + source_sha256 + ')' }}
EOF
echo done
